parameter_matrix.note: Check PCB land pattern & height profile.
A part wins only if its operating Vin range strictly encompasses the counterpart on both ends.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.
Tighter Vout tolerance improves ADC reference and digital rail margin.
Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.
Lower Iq directly extends sleep-mode battery life in always-on IoT/portable rails.
Lower dropout allows regulation deeper into Li-ion / 3.7 V discharge curves.

parameter_matrix.note: Non-ceramic-stable LDOs oscillate with low-ESR MLCCs unless series resistance or tantalum is used.
Higher PSRR attenuates upstream switching-converter ripple on analog/RF rails.
Critical for RF VCOs, low-noise ADCs, and precision sensor excitation.
Lower θJA yields lower junction temperature rise ΔTj = (Vin - Vout) × Iout × θJA.
Keep steady-state Tj at least 15–25 °C below Tj,max for production reliability.

swap_risks: CAUTION PACKAGE HEIGHT/PROFILE: AP2112K-3.3TRG1 (SOT-23-5) vs NCP114ASN330T1G (TSOT-23-5) share the same JEDEC land pattern pitch, but thin-profile TSOT (~1.0 mm) vs standard SOT (~1.45 mm) differs in body height; verify enclosure Z-clearance, SMT nozzle height, and solder fillet spec.
HIGH LOAD CURRENT DERATING: NCP114ASN330T1G supplies up to 300 mA (p.3) compared to AP2112K-3.3TRG1 at 600 mA (p.8); confirm peak inrush and thermal dissipation margin.
HIGH THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA is 28% higher on NCP114ASN330T1G (AP2112K-3.3TRG1: 184 °C/W p.3 vs NCP114ASN330T1G: 236 °C/W p.2); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.
HIGH MINIMUM SUPPLY FLOOR: AP2112K-3.3TRG1 requires Vin,min >= 2.5 V (p.3) vs 1.7 V on the counterpart; confirm low-battery / brown-out operation still clears the higher floor.
engineering_verdict: AP2112K-3.3TRG1 (Diodes Incorporated, SOT-23-5) and NCP114ASN330T1G (onsemi, TSOT-23-5) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required alternatives: the PCB land pattern is compatible, but passive retuning or rating derating is mandatory because package code differs (SOT-23-5 vs TSOT-23-5; same land pattern, different body profile); Iout,max rating drops >=20%; θJA worsens 28% (thermal derating verification required). Under a representative 5 V → 3.3 V rail at 150 mA (255 mW), estimated self-heating is ΔTj ≈ 46.9 °C on AP2112K-3.3TRG1 (θJA 184 °C/W) vs 60.2 °C on NCP114ASN330T1G (θJA 236 °C/W), while quiescent draw spans a 1.1x ratio (55 µA (p.8) vs 50 µA (p.3)). Primary bench gotchas to watch: AP2112K-3.3TRG1 "6.5 V Abs Max & SOT25 Thermal Limit at 600 mA From 5 V Input" (p.3) and NCP114ASN330T1G "TSOP-5 (TSOT-23-5) Has Worse Dropout (150 mV), Load Reg (28 mV), and RθJA (236 C/W) Than Page-1 UDFN Specs" (p.3). BOM decision: Choose AP2112K-3.3TRG1 when load current exceeds 300 mA (up to 600 mA) or lower package θJA (184 °C/W) is needed for thermal margin; choose NCP114ASN330T1G when low Vin-Vout headroom requires 150 mV dropout. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.1) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
